title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 終活とは、人生の最期に向けて身の回りを整理することだ。私も<u>老いて</u>きて、医者の言葉から先が短いことを<u>悟り</u>、終活を始めた。銀行に<u>預けて</u>いるお金の相続先や、<u>遺言</u>書の形式など、さまざまなことを<u>決断</u>しなければならない。
english_translation: As we move toward the end of life, it's all about organizing personal affairs. As I got older, I realized from my doctor's words that my life was short, so I started to prepare for the end of my life. I have to decide where to pass on all the money I've deposited in the bank, the format of my will, and various other matters.
